intended_behavior: After dynamically creating the Pydantic model with create_model(), the method should invoke model_rebuild() on the model if necessary (e.g., when Pydantic version is > 2.11 and the model contains typing.Literal fields). This ensures the model is fully defined and compatible with newer Pydantic versions, preventing runtime errors. The existing functionality of extracting type hints, creating input models for validation, and supporting different parameter types should be preserved.
